notes: 28 beads, 90 edges; 77 kept as real. Proposals by kind: false 1, missing 13, partial 4, split 3, wrong-way 6. Shape: almost every bead here sits at level 7 or 8 because of one level-6 prerequisite (BD-003, N38a-09, N38b-18, N33a-04 or an N41-OPEN part); the deps lists are mostly honest, and the larger fault is the reverse: acceptance items that call later surfaces, above all `cargo xtask check-generated` (BD-004, level 13) in N40-01, N40-02, N40-03, N40-06 and the 'no other of the six checks' clauses of N33c-09, N34-07 and N34-08; made honest by adding edges they would cost hundreds of layers (N40-01 alone 678), so each proposal moves the item to N38b-20 or N34-14 instead, which also need N40-01..N40-06 / N33c-09 as deps they lack today. BD-003 is the main lever: N34-07 and N34-08 need only the xtask skeleton. N33a-06 -> N33a-05 sits on the 169-bead longest chain and removing it would drop 3,365 beads one level, but it is real: frob-core's build.rs reads receipts/HEAD and LOCK_DIGEST, which only `check-stack --write-receipt` writes, and fails closed without them; not proposed. BD-026 -> BD-003 holds N12-02 and N39a-01 at level 8 (BD-026 is not on this list). No start-ready bead found: the six pilots really use frob-conformance, pilots.toml and the harness.
